instruction:
TF-PIM-001 Wave D'.1 — close L31 axis I (cross-repo reusable-workflow self-SHA awareness gap) by adding `inputs.scp-sha` (required) to `.github/workflows/policy-check.yml` + pre-flight validation step + replacing the wrong `github.workflow_sha` ref in BOTH cross-repo checkout steps + updating scaffolder template `templates/adopter-wrapper.yml.tmpl` to pass `scp-sha: {{SCP_SHA}}` + new workflow-selftest fixture exercising axis I validation + scaffolder test contract update.

THIS IS A TIER 2 KERNEL-DANGEROUS FEDERATION-PRIMITIVE CHANGE (same class as Wave D). Operator-attended fire mandatory per impl WP plan-doc v0.7 §4 Wave D'.1 Tier classification.

# Authoritative source-of-truth

The verbatim execution-class text for every edit lives in the companion doc `docs/plans/TF-PIM-001-wave-d-prime-spec-draft.md` (landed on SCP main 2026-05-23 via PR #143 squash sha `d62d6935a685f4f5c639207c1d340dfcb5c01ec3`). READ THE COMPANION FIRST. It contains:

- **Companion §2** — `inputs.scp-sha` declaration YAML + pre-flight validation step YAML (lines 19-78 in companion). This is the verbatim text to insert into `policy-check.yml`.
- **Companion §3** — `.scp-runtime` checkout step v2 replacement YAML (replaces `ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}` with `ref: ${{ inputs.scp-sha }}`; lines 88-112).
- **Companion §4** — `_scp-workflow` checkout step v2 replacement YAML (also replaces `ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}` with `ref: ${{ inputs.scp-sha }}`; v0.7 REMOVED the `|| github.workflow_sha` fallback per R2 Lens A HIGH-005 closure; lines 116-157).
- **Companion §5** — scaffolder template diff (adds `scp-sha: {{SCP_SHA}}` in caller-job `with:` block; lines 161-193).
- **Companion §7** — workflow-selftest fixture spec (5 test cases; lines 240-262).

The instruction below is a high-level dispatch summary. Codex MUST cross-reference the companion for the verbatim YAML on each EDIT.

# Required edits

## EDIT 1 — Add `inputs.scp-sha` workflow_call input + pre-flight validation step in `.github/workflows/policy-check.yml`

**Insertion location for input declaration:** at the end of the `on.workflow_call.inputs:` block, AFTER `simulate-app-token-failure:` (the 9th existing input from Wave E) and BEFORE the `permissions:` block. Use anchored extraction to find:
```
awk '/^      simulate-app-token-failure:/,/^        default: false$/' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml
```
The next non-blank line after this block is the insertion point.

**Verbatim YAML to insert** — per companion §2 lines 25-43. Includes `description:` with full L31 axis I rationale + closure cross-reference. Sets `required: true` + `type: string`.

**Insertion location for pre-flight validation step:** in the `policy-check` job's `steps:` array, IMMEDIATELY AFTER the existing 'Checkout caller repository' step + IMMEDIATELY BEFORE the existing 'Simulate App token-exchange failure' step (Wave E selftest fixture). Use anchored extraction to find both anchors.

**Verbatim YAML to insert** — per companion §2 lines 50-78 (`Validate inputs.scp-sha` step). Includes shell script that:
- Sets `SCP_SHA` env var from `inputs.scp-sha`
- Computes `SCP_SHA_LEN` BEFORE validation (for use in error message)
- Validates non-empty (exit 1 + SCP-E001 on empty)
- Validates 40-char lowercase hex regex (exit 1 + SCP-E001 on mismatch; REDACTS SCP_SHA value in error message — only prints char-count — per v0.7 R2 Lens A HIGH-004 hygiene closure)
- Echos validated value on pass

## EDIT 2 — Replace `ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}` with `ref: ${{ inputs.scp-sha }}` in `.scp-runtime` checkout step

**Anchored location:** find the step block. Anchor:
```
awk '/Checkout SCP runtime repository/,/persist-credentials: false/' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml
```

**Verbatim YAML replacement** — per companion §3 lines 88-112. The replacement preserves:
- `if: github.repository != 'jrnb2024/standards-control-plane-'` (selftest skip guard from PR #142)
- `uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2`
- `repository: jrnb2024/standards-control-plane-` (hardcoded per PR #142 axis H closure)
- `token: ${{ steps.scp-app-token.outputs.token }}`
- `path: .scp-runtime`
- `fetch-depth: 1`
- `persist-credentials: false`

ONLY change: `ref:` line goes from `${{ github.workflow_sha }}` to `${{ inputs.scp-sha }}`. Comment block above the step updated per companion §3 to capture axis I closure rationale.

## EDIT 3 — Same `ref:` fix on `_scp-workflow` checkout step (axis I parallel)

**Anchored location:**
```
awk '/Check out SCP repo at workflow ref for schema lookup/,/persist-credentials: false/' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml
```

**Verbatim YAML replacement** — per companion §4 lines 119-157.

CRITICAL: v0.7 REMOVED the `|| github.workflow_sha` fallback that v0.6 had retained for SCP-self compatibility. The new `ref:` is pure `${{ inputs.scp-sha }}` with NO fallback. This closes R2 Lens A HIGH-005 silent-downgrade attack (cross-repo callers omitting `scp-sha:` would silently fall through to `github.workflow_sha` = caller's wrapper SHA = re-introduces axis I).

For SCP-self / workflow-selftest compatibility, the selftest fixture is updated in EDIT 4 to pass `scp-sha:` explicitly (`${{ github.sha }}` in selftest context = SCP HEAD = correct SCP-side SHA).

The replacement preserves: `if: always()`, `uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e...`, `repository: jrnb2024/standards-control-plane-`, `token: ${{ steps.scp-app-token.outputs.token || github.token }}` (token fallback intentional + load-bearing for SCP-self), `path: _scp-workflow`, `persist-credentials: false`.

ONLY change: `ref:` line goes from `${{ github.workflow_sha }}` (or `${{ inputs.scp-sha || github.workflow_sha }}` if v0.6 had been folded — but it wasn't) to `${{ inputs.scp-sha }}`. Comment block above the step updated per companion §4 to capture v0.7 R2 closure rationale.

## EDIT 4 — New workflow-selftest fixture at `tests/workflow/fixture-scp-sha-validation/`

Create a new fixture directory + fixture artefacts per companion §7 spec. The fixture exercises 5 test cases:

1. **Happy path** — selftest passes `scp-sha: ${{ github.sha }}` explicitly; full pipeline green
2. **Required-input-missing** — selftest variant passes `scp-sha: ""` (empty); pre-flight fires + emits SCP-E001 + exit 1 BEFORE App-token-exchange
3. **Wrong SHA shape** — selftest variant passes `scp-sha: "not-a-sha"`; pre-flight regex fails + emits SCP-E001 with char-count (redacted value per v0.7 R2 HIGH-004 hygiene)
4. **Mismatched-but-valid-shape SHA** — selftest variant passes `scp-sha: "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"`; pre-flight passes (shape OK); `.scp-runtime` checkout fails with `actions/checkout` error; downstream skips; exit 128
5. **Happy path cross-repo (full integration)** — pre-authored fixture wrapper invokes policy-check.yml with `scp-sha: ${{ github.sha }}` via the wrapper-bump-simulation pattern; full pipeline runs to completion; selftest orchestrator asserts success

Fixture file structure (Codex authors based on companion §7 + existing `tests/workflow/fixture-pass/` + `tests/workflow/fixture-fail/` as exemplars):
- `tests/workflow/fixture-scp-sha-validation/README.md` — fixture documentation
- `tests/workflow/fixture-scp-sha-validation/services.yml` (empty / minimal — same shape as fixture-pass)
- `tests/workflow/fixture-scp-sha-validation/expected-annotations.json` — expected outcomes per test case
- `.github/workflows/workflow-selftest.yml` — update to invoke the new fixture in 5 jobs (one per test case); each job calls `./.github/workflows/policy-check.yml` with the appropriate `scp-sha:` value

## EDIT 5 — Scaffolder template `templates/adopter-wrapper.yml.tmpl`

**Anchored location:**
```
awk '/^    with:$/,/^[^[:space:]]/' templates/adopter-wrapper.yml.tmpl
```

**Verbatim diff** — per companion §5 lines 161-193. Adds `scp-sha: {{SCP_SHA}}` in the caller-job `with:` block, AFTER `scorecard-emit: {{SCORECARD_EMIT}}`, with the comment block explaining dual-use (pin + input from same source-of-truth value at scaffold time).

## EDIT 6 — Scaffolder test `tests/scaffolder/test_scaffold_downstream.sh`

Extend the existing `assert_wrapper_contract` function (already amended in PR #142 for axes F+G) to add an assertion that the generated wrapper contains `scp-sha: <SHA>` matching the `@<SHA>` pin. Add:

```bash
  # L31 axis I closure (v0.7) — scaffolder template includes scp-sha: input matching
  # the @<SHA> pin. Per ASC-2026-05-22-001 + plan-doc v0.7 §11 + companion §5.
  WRAPPER_PIN_SHA=$(grep -oE 'jrnb2024/standards-control-plane-/.github/workflows/policy-check.yml@[a-f0-9]{40}' "$wrapper" | awk -F@ '{print $2}' | head -1)
  WRAPPER_INPUT_SHA=$(grep -oE 'scp-sha: [a-f0-9]{40}' "$wrapper" | awk '{print $2}' | head -1)
  [ -n "$WRAPPER_PIN_SHA" ] || fail "wrapper missing @<SHA> pin"
  [ -n "$WRAPPER_INPUT_SHA" ] || fail "wrapper missing scp-sha: <SHA> input (L31 axis I closure)"
  [ "$WRAPPER_PIN_SHA" = "$WRAPPER_INPUT_SHA" ] || fail "wrapper @<SHA> pin ($WRAPPER_PIN_SHA) and scp-sha: input ($WRAPPER_INPUT_SHA) do not match — they MUST mirror each other per ADOPT-001 §12.7.16b bump procedure (L31 axis I)"
```

Insert AT THE END of `assert_wrapper_contract` (after the existing `secrets: inherit` assertion).

# Invariants to preserve

1. **All existing `policy-check.yml` invariants from Wave D + PR #142 preserved.** No re-write of unrelated sections. EDIT 1+2+3 are surgical: add 1 input + 1 step + change 2 `ref:` lines.
2. **All existing `templates/adopter-wrapper.yml.tmpl` invariants from PR #142 preserved.** EDIT 5 is surgical: add 1 line in `with:` block.
3. **All existing `tests/scaffolder/test_scaffold_downstream.sh` invariants from PR #142 preserved.** EDIT 6 is surgical: add 1 assertion block at end of `assert_wrapper_contract`.
4. **NO `secrets:` declaration on `policy-check.yml`'s `on.workflow_call.secrets`** — Option α per ASC-2026-05-22-001 ratified caller-side `secrets: inherit` (already in scaffolder template); §12.7.10 invariant preserved literally (no `secrets: inherit` IN policy-check.yml).
5. **`actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2` SHA pin** preserved on all checkout sites. Do not upgrade.
6. **`actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0` SHA pin** preserved (no change to App-token-exchange step itself).
7. **YAML syntax valid** after edits — `python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/policy-check.yml'))"` must succeed; same for adopter-wrapper.yml.tmpl post-substitution.
8. **Existing fixture-pass / fixture-fail / fixture-simulate-token-exchange-failure** in `workflow-selftest.yml` PRESERVED unchanged. EDIT 4 adds NEW fixture jobs; doesn't modify existing ones.
9. **Scope discipline** — only 5 files modified: `.github/workflows/policy-check.yml`, `.github/workflows/workflow-selftest.yml`, `templates/adopter-wrapper.yml.tmpl`, `tests/scaffolder/test_scaffold_downstream.sh`, plus the NEW `tests/workflow/fixture-scp-sha-validation/` directory (counted as 1 scope-boundary entry covering the whole directory).
10. **No additional adopter wrappers touched** — PIM PR #259 wrapper bump is a separate operator-attended ceremony post-merge (Wave G v2; not in this dispatch).

verify_commands: python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/policy-check.yml')); print('policy-check.yml YAML PARSE OK')"
python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/workflow-selftest.yml')); print('workflow-selftest.yml YAML PARSE OK')"

python3 -c "import yaml; content=open('templates/adopter-wrapper.yml.tmpl').read(); yaml.safe_load(content.replace('{{DEFAULT_BRANCH}}', 'main').replace('{{SCP_SHA}}', 'a' * 40).replace('{{SCORECARD_EMIT}}', 'false')); print('adopter-wrapper.yml.tmpl YAML PARSE OK (post-substitution)')"
grep -F 'scp-sha:' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | head -3
test "$(grep -cE '^\s+scp-sha:$' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml)" = 1 && echo 'scp-sha: input declared exactly once in policy-check.yml inputs block'

grep -F 'required: true' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | grep -B1 'required: true' | head -5 && grep -B5 'required: true' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | grep -A5 'scp-sha:' | grep -F 'required: true' && echo 'scp-sha required: true'
grep -F 'Validate inputs.scp-sha' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | head -1 && echo 'pre-flight validation step present'
grep -F 'SCP_SHA_LEN="${#SCP_SHA}"' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml && echo 'pre-flight validation computes SCP_SHA_LEN BEFORE validation per R2 HIGH-004 hygiene'
! grep -F '(got '\''${SCP_SHA}'\'')' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml && echo 'NO direct SCP_SHA interpolation in error message (R2 HIGH-004 redact-on-error hygiene)'
grep -F 'value redacted on validation failure' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml && echo 'pre-flight validation error redacts SCP_SHA value per R2 HIGH-004 hygiene'
test "$(grep -cF 'ref: ${{ inputs.scp-sha }}' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml)" = 2 && echo 'BOTH checkout steps use inputs.scp-sha (no fallback)'
! grep -F 'ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml && echo 'NO github.workflow_sha ref usage (axis I closure)'
! grep -F 'ref: ${{ inputs.scp-sha || github.workflow_sha }}' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml && echo 'NO fallback expression (R2 HIGH-005 closure)'
test "$(grep -cF 'persist-credentials: false' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml)" = 3 && echo 'persist-credentials: false preserved on all 3 checkout sites'
test "$(grep -cF 'uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml)" = 3 && echo 'actions/checkout SHA pin preserved'
grep -F 'uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml && echo 'create-github-app-token SHA pin preserved'
! grep -qE 'secrets:[[:space:]]*inherit' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml && echo 'NO secrets: inherit IN policy-check.yml (§12.7.10 invariant preserved)'
grep -F 'scp-sha: {{SCP_SHA}}' templates/adopter-wrapper.yml.tmpl && echo 'scaffolder template includes scp-sha: {{SCP_SHA}} (axis I closure)'
test "$(grep -cF '{{SCP_SHA}}' templates/adopter-wrapper.yml.tmpl)" = 2 && echo 'BOTH @<SHA> pin AND scp-sha: input use same {{SCP_SHA}} substitution (dual-use mirroring)'

test -f tests/workflow/fixture-scp-sha-validation/README.md && test -f tests/workflow/fixture-scp-sha-validation/services.yml && test -f tests/workflow/fixture-scp-sha-validation/expected-annotations.json && echo 'fixture-scp-sha-validation directory + 3 artefacts present'
grep -F 'fixture-scp-sha-validation' .github/workflows/workflow-selftest.yml | head -1 && echo 'workflow-selftest.yml invokes new fixture'
test "$(grep -cF 'WRAPPER_INPUT_SHA' tests/scaffolder/test_scaffold_downstream.sh)" -ge 1 && echo 'scaffolder test asserts scp-sha input present + matches pin'
bash tests/scaffolder/test_scaffold_downstream.sh && echo 'scaffolder test passes (extended assertions)'

CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD -- 2>/dev/null | sort); EXPECTED=$(printf '%s\n' '.github/workflows/policy-check.yml' '.github/workflows/workflow-selftest.yml' 'templates/adopter-wrapper.yml.tmpl' 'tests/scaffolder/test_scaffold_downstream.sh' 'tests/workflow/fixture-scp-sha-validation/README.md' 'tests/workflow/fixture-scp-sha-validation/services.yml' 'tests/workflow/fixture-scp-sha-validation/expected-annotations.json' | sort); test "$CHANGED" = "$EXPECTED" && echo 'SCOPE OK: exactly the 7 Wave D-prime files changed'
ADDED=$(git diff HEAD | grep -c '^+[^+]' || true); test "$ADDED" -ge 80 && test "$ADDED" -le 250 && echo "DIFF SIZE OK: $ADDED added lines (budget 80..250)"

INPUT_LINE=$(grep -nF 'scp-sha:' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); SIMULATE_LINE=$(grep -nF 'simulate-app-token-failure:' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); test -n "$INPUT_LINE" && test -n "$SIMULATE_LINE" && test "$INPUT_LINE" -gt "$SIMULATE_LINE" && echo "INPUT ORDER OK: scp-sha ($INPUT_LINE) follows simulate-app-token-failure ($SIMULATE_LINE)"

VALIDATE_LINE=$(grep -nF 'Validate inputs.scp-sha' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); CHECKOUT_LINE=$(grep -nF 'Checkout caller repository' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); SIMULATE_STEP_LINE=$(grep -nF 'Simulate App token-exchange failure' .github/workflows/policy-check.yml | head -1 | cut -d: -f1); test -n "$VALIDATE_LINE" && test -n "$CHECKOUT_LINE" && test -n "$SIMULATE_STEP_LINE" && test "$CHECKOUT_LINE" -lt "$VALIDATE_LINE" && test "$VALIDATE_LINE" -lt "$SIMULATE_STEP_LINE" && echo "STEP ORDER OK: Checkout caller ($CHECKOUT_LINE) < Validate scp-sha ($VALIDATE_LINE) < Simulate failure ($SIMULATE_STEP_LINE)"
